primary_task: Implement or harden a webhook handler (signature verification, idempotency, retry, dead-letter queue) in the repository.

requirements.name: Read/Write/Edit/Bash
requirements.evidence: 'Implement handlers and delivery paths that survive duplicates, retries, and reordering'
requirements.basis: bash: run shell commands on Linux x86_64: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session

requirements.name: queue infrastructure / dedupe store
requirements.evidence: 'Queue-backed async processing'; 'Deduplication store with a TTL'
requirements.basis: The manifest allows local servers and installable packages but names no queue; need to check one can be run locally.

requirements.name: local tunneling to real providers
requirements.evidence: 'Local tunneling for development against real providers'
requirements.basis: lacks: network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused

requirements.name: answers from the invoking agent/user
requirements.evidence: 'Ask the invoking agent for event sources, delivery guarantees, and volume expectations'
requirements.basis: ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation

notes: Tunnelling and provider sandboxes are listed practices, not musts. Live provider testing would be BLOCKED.
